g_ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
g_ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

f_ir.name: loss_diff_advantage_clamp_normalized_mean
f_ir.intuition: Introduce explicit normalization of the weighted clamped margin by the sum of weights to ensure scale-invariance and stable gradient behavior. This normalization prevents arbitrary scaling of losses due to batch weight magnitude variation, maintaining a meaningful average preference loss.
f_ir.pseudocode:
adv = advantage_gap
margin = clamp(lpw - lpl, min=0) * adv
weighted_margin = weight * margin
loss = sum(weighted_margin) / sum(weight)
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']

    margin_raw = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_clamped = ops.clamp(margin_raw, 0.0, 1e9)
    margin = ops.mul(margin_clamped, adv)

    if weight is None:
        weight = ops.ones_like(margin)

    weighted_margin = ops.mul(weight, margin)
    sum_weighted_margin = ops.sum(weighted_margin)
    sum_weight = ops.sum(weight)

    loss = ops.div(sum_weighted_margin, ops.maximum(sum_weight, 1e-9))
    return loss
